ANN 1.1.2 by Sunil Arya and David M. Mount (2010-01-27).
Project: https://www.cs.umd.edu/~mount/ANN/
Source: https://www.cs.umd.edu/~mount/ANN/Files/1.1.2/ann_1.1.2.zip
Downloaded 2026-10-06; archive SHA-256: 1b54b58ae697202a09d793de51ee9200fe1d5c39def78d9e8f5c0d08e48afaf5
Copyright and LGPL terms are preserved in Copyright.txt and License.txt.

Vendored src/ and include/ are upstream, except include/ANN/ANN.h:
ANN_USE_LINF selects the upstream-documented maximum-distance macros instead
of the default Euclidean metric. The Bazel target propagates this definition
to every caller. No search or construction algorithm has been changed.

Benchmark ID: ann_fr; ANNkd_tree, default bucket size 1 and sliding-midpoint
splitting (explicitly selected). Static 2D uint32 coordinates converted exactly
to double. annkFRSearch uses eps=0 and the default unlimited search; self-matches
and duplicate input points are retained. Each query first counts with k=0, then
reports with k=count using the documented API. Output-index storage is reused
between queries. Both traversals and nearest-neighbor ordering costs are timed.
The L-infinity radius is NOT squared. Square centers may be half-integers, all
exactly representable for uint32 input. General rectangles use an enclosing
square followed by inclusive filtering. No floating-point coordinate rescaling.
ANN uses global query state: this adapter is for the serial benchmark only.
This is a kd-tree competitor, not an SFC implementation.
